consumption.operatorHoursNote: M3-03 fixed the ceiling in operator hours on the assumption of a human operator. This asset was authored by an agent in a single session, so no comparable human hour figure exists. Reporting an invented number would corrupt the Track A cost axis; mi3san decides how agent-executed work is accounted before the cost axis is compared across candidates.

revisionLedger.reason: initial authoring: layers, control cages, draw order, deformers, masks

rest pose corrected to a closed mouth; jaw rotation replaced by a single jaw displacement field shared by the aperture and everything parented to the lower jaw; dentition repositioned to straddle the closed lip line

consumption.ceilingReached: nativeAssetVersions is at the approved maximum. Any further change to the asset requires a new mi3san decision on M3-03 before it is made.

provenance.characterBibleReference: public/assets/cutout/chars/sensei-stand.png was viewed as identity reference only; it is not read by the asset and is not a deliverable input

knownFailures.observed: The rest-pose aperture cage enclosed roughly 500 square asset units, so a mouth that was meant to read as closed still exposed part of the oral cavity through its own mask.
knownFailures.resolution: Rest arcs brought to a one-unit seam; a conformance check now fails if the rest aperture exceeds 400.

knownFailures.observed: Sutherland-Hodgman returned the subject polygon unchanged when the clip polygon was degenerate, because every half-plane test passes on collinear edges. A fully shut mouth would have been reported as fully revealing its interior.
knownFailures.resolution: Degenerate clips are rejected before iteration; a unit test pins the behaviour. Generalised as AP-010.

knownFailures.observed: The aperture's lower arc was driven by an independent vertical offset while the lower dentition was driven by a separately pivoted rotation. At full open the two diverged and the lower teeth fell outside the aperture that was supposed to reveal them.
knownFailures.resolution: One jaw displacement field now drives the aperture's lower arc and every layer parented to the lower jaw. Generalised as AP-011.

knownFailures.observed: Layer parallax under yaw is applied per layer independently, so at the adopted +/-15 degree limit no check yet proves that adjacent layers stay connected. A visible seam between the muzzle pads and the head base is plausible and is exactly the T7 layer-gap observable.
knownFailures.resolution: Not fixed. Measure on real frames in M3-05 rather than asserting it here; recorded so it is not mistaken for a passing property.

notEvaluated.note: M3-04 creates an asset. It does not render, rank, or select anything.
